description: Onboard a merchant feed with one call: send payload and canonical_target and Rosetta fingerprints the shape, reuses a frozen adapter when it has one and otherwise plans, freezes or queues the mapping by confidence. The status says stable, provisional or needs review. Pass samples, up to a few more payloads, to improve the guess, and merchant_id to label the integration in the audit trail. The first call for a new shape provisions and stores an adapter and may queue a review. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

canonical_target.description: The id of a built-in schema (see list_canonical_schemas) or a whole schema with an id and fields.

enum.description: The values the field may take.

path.description: The dot path of the field.

required.description: Whether the schema requires the field.

type.description: The field type, for example string, number or boolean.

id.description: A stable id for the schema.

merchant_id.description: A label for the integration, kept in the audit trail.

samples.description: More payloads of the same shape, to improve the guess.

name: ingest_with_rosetta
